name: Port values, host functions and host types, with C callbacks that reach their state through a context pointer

comments.text: Each callback's userdata is a raw pointer to its HostCall, cast with reinterpret<raw u8~*>; one trampoline serves functions, methods, statics, operators and constructors. Object instances are slot ids in the pointer's bits; value types hand Nyx the bytes of a C-layout struct.
